records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Cost of sales increased by $4.9 million, or 5%, during the three months ended March 31, 2022, compared to the three months ended March 31, 2021, primarily due to increased material costs.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: While managing decreased demand in many regions across the globe, we are now operating at all of our business locations.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Income from operations decreased by $4.1 million during the three months ended March 31, 2022, compared to the same period in the prior year primarily due to lower sales volume and variable cost inefficiencies associated with supply chain interruptions,

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Selling, general, and administrative expense decreased by $1.1 million during the three months ended March 31, 2022, compared to the three months ended March 31, 2021, primarily due to lower personnel costs.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Income from operations decreased by $2.1 million during the three months ended March 31, 2022 compared to the same period in the prior year, primarily due to higher selling, general and administrative costs and a legal settlement reached during the three months ended March 31, 2022.
